svg.text: Resolver cost: hops = number of changes; eth_getLogs per hop. Measured read path at h=50: 203 ms median over HTTP RPC, over the J2945/1 budget (#39) — hence the cache on BP-302.

svg.text: require(ecrecover(hash, v, r, s) == identityOwner(id)); nonce[signer]++ → the relayer pays gas; the vehicle signs.
